name: overwatch2
aspect_notes: Approximate 16:9 search regions, not pixel-exact UI contracts. Native 16:10/ultrawide retains height-relative HUD size with left/right/center anchors; stretched or customized HUDs need calibration. For pillarbox/letterbox footage use pixels(..., letterboxed=True) or crop to the content first. UI scale, patches and spectator overlays can shift regions.
alive_rules: Player crosshair, hero health, ability cooldowns and direct aim control support alive state; ammo is hero dependent.
dead_rules: Top-left ELIMINATED BY or KILLED BY, top-right respawn timer, or death tint with other death evidence.
spectating_rules: Bottom-center KILL CAM / CÂMERA DE ABATES, change-hero prompt, or following a teammate after death.
highlights: Team kills, ultimate combos, environmental eliminations, clutch point contests or payload pushes.
lowlights: Wasted ultimate, stagger death, missed saves, or abandoning a contested objective.
